dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: So, this is an "abode" created by the Adepti of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: "Mighty and illuminated" indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you settling in okay?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: The environs here are most comfortable. The air is pure and peaceful, free of taint or pollution.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I am certain that your honest spirit was what allowed such an abode to be made manifest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, that matters?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: But of course. All things here are fashioned from your every thought. As your thoughts fly, so shall they be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Couldn't we use this as a mood detector, then...?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Indeed, you are most discerning. That assessment is correct.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: But should you wish to use this as a way to control your thoughts and avoid treading the path of evil, that seems too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rigid?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Mortal hearts are filled with thoughts beyond count, complex and cluttered...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: "Rage" may drive people to commit acts of violence, yet may also imbue them with courage.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Unpleasant though "Envy" may sound, so too may it push people to strive harder.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: "Fear" is despised by all, yet should one so utterly lack it that they pursue only their own pleasure in all things, without regard for right or wrong, how would they be any different from a base beast?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Such emotions whisper evil into mortal hearts, yet they can also guide them towards good. The same holds true for the sword in your hand. You choose whether it shall be used to ward off evil or scourge the innocent.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Hehe... But I imagine one such as yourself must have long learned how to control your thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't always control them...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Oh? And when can you not?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Right now. I'm getting a bit sleepy listening...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Hahaha. Apologies, 'twas I who spoke too much. I was for many years a teacher, and could not help but launch into a lecture.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I shall steep a pot of tea. Let us enjoy it together and refresh ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Certainly. Are you interested in mathematics? I often used that to pass the time while I dwelt on the moon.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I have not laid my arithmetic tomes down after arriving in Liyue either. I sometimes discuss the study of the mathematical sciences with the one you call Cloud Retainer.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: That said... our perspectives on it seem to differ somewhat.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Most of Cloud Retainer's research in the field centers around studying the mechanical arts. She believes that mathematics should have practical applications, and not remain purely theoretical.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: However, I believe that it is wondrous in itself. To study mathematics solely for the purpose of creating mechanical devices would inevitably destroy its inherent beauty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The... the beauty of numbers and mathematics?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: That's right. For example... have you ever wondered why one finch plus another finch equals two finches?

choices.text: Uh... what now? Of course it's two...

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: That's right. This is a natural law, one that everyone knows.

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: So, were we to express our observations as an equation, that is, write down "one plus one equals two"...

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: Would you not think to ask, "Why does one plus one equals two?"

choices.text: Uh... come again? It's still two...

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: As I see it, though it is widely accepted that "one plus one equals two," it still lacks... a more objective and rigorous logical grounding.

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: I have conferred with Cloud Retainer several times already on this point alone.

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: She initially thought that such discourse was "nonsense," but after hearing my explanation, she, too, became interested in this type of theoretical research.

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: We spoke until midnight, and were still hungry to explore the subject more deeply, but as we both had matters to attend to, we could only agree to adjourn and continue the discussion another day.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I heard the Sumeru Akademiya is also researching mathematics...

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: You mean the Darshan they call "Rtawahist," I presume? Hehe, I did once visit them during my previous wanderings.

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: The research being conducted there seems incredibly profound. I gained tremendous insight from reading but a few of their books.

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: That is why I'm preparing to apply to the Akademiya to further my studies.

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: I see nothing wrong with that. When one encounters a great teacher, it's only natural to seek their guidance.

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: Besides, the Akademiya must be a gathering place of sages. I do not doubt they uphold the principle of education for all, and will not easily reject those who seek to study there.

response.speaker: Zibai
response.text: Hmm... It seems I shall learn a great many new stories on my journey to Sumeru.

choices.text: Going to study at the Akademiya...
What else could it be, three?
H—How many else could it be?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: In a place so tranquil as this, the best thing to do is relax your body and mind, and let your spirit wander freely.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I believe that mortals would call this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Spacing out?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Indeed. Spacing out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there some special technique behind adepti spacing out?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Were I to force the issue through adeptal arts, it could hardly be called "spacing out," now could it?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Indeed, few can achieve this seemingly ordinary and straightforward emptiness of mind.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Most will find that though they close their eyes, hold their breath, and force themselves to relax, their thoughts still boil and churn, playing out countless fantasies...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: And they then open their eyes to greater exhaustion than before they closed them.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Perhaps this is why they say, "peace of mind is hard to find"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Zibai.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Good morning. The morning light is fair, and most fitting for a stroll.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Zibai.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Mm, may you have sweet dreams tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: With these bookshelves, I should be able to house my collection.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: When did I buy them? Hmm... All of them were picked up during my travels.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: It may be because I've traveled to too many places, but I accumulated such a trove before I knew it.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Yes. This is a most quiet and secluded place, perfect for solitary contemplation.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I may enjoy wandering the world like a cloud, but I still need a place to return to after my travels.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: And well... Heh. Let's just say this place is much better than where I used to "live alone."
